changes.text: Collapsed panels are `inert` and `visibility: hidden`, so their content no longer stays in the tab order and the accessibility tree. The `dssoca/vanilla.js` behaviour toggles `inert` together with `hidden`.
The header label uses `text-align: start` (was `left`), so it aligns correctly under `dir="rtl"`.

Plain-HTML behaviour in `dssoca/vanilla.js`: headers toggle their panel, Arrow / Home / End move between headers, `data-ss-multiple` on the root allows several open sections, and the root emits `ss:change` with the open ids.
New `overflow` prop (`'truncate' | 'wrap'`, default `wrap`) controls how a long header label behaves; `truncate` keeps it on one line with an ellipsis. The root carries it as `data-overflow`.
The chevron renders through the shared `Icon` `chevron` glyph instead of a CSS-border caret, and its size follows the resolved `size` of the accordion.
Panel markup gains a wrapper: `.panel` → `.panel-clip` → `.panel-inner` (was `.panel` → `.panel-inner`). Plain-HTML markup and custom selectors that target the panel need the new `.panel-clip` level.
The `--ss-acc-chevron` token is gone; the chevron size now comes from the icon scale.
Panel padding is present from the first reveal frame, so content animates as a stable padded block instead of snapping in.
The chevron stays centered with no vertical drift between the open and closed states.
Generated header and panel ids derive from `$props.id()` instead of `Math.random()`, so server- and client-rendered ids match. `idBase` still overrides them.

New component: a stack of collapsible sections built from `items` and a `panel` snippet, single-open by default or `multiple`, with controlled (`value`, bindable) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) state, `onChange`, an optional `header` snippet, `size`, `headingLevel` and `idBase`. Arrow / Home / End move focus between headers.
